Design Notes — Identity Lock

  • Blond spiky hair, pale skin — NOT crimson skin.
  • Yellow eyes + fanged grin; horns deep maroon at the base brightening to crimson tips — never black (those are Enma's).
  • White hannya mask worn on the head; orange+green+gold kimono, gold clover crest.
  • Black gauntlets. Keep the reference's soft dreamy glow, bloom and painterly finish — never flat studio.
  • Pure Edo fantasy; no modern tech.
